wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Help Me Fill browser extension project overview. Explain its purpose as an AI-powered form filling tool that combines PDF document processing with intelligent field mapping. Document the privacy-first approach where PDF parsing happens locally while AI suggestions require explicit user consent. Describe the target audience including professionals who frequently fill forms from documents, and explain how it differs from traditional form fillers by using AI to understand document context. Include the core value proposition of reducing manual data entry while maintaining security and user control.

<blog>

# Help Me Fill: AI-Powered Browser Extension for Form Filling

## Project Introduction

**Help Me Fill (帮我填)** is a Chrome/Edge browser extension that leverages artificial intelligence to help users fill web forms by reviewing and mapping information from PDF documents. The extension provides a secure, user-controlled workflow where document parsing happens locally while AI suggestions are sent only after explicit user consent.

### Core Goals and Objectives

- **Privacy-first approach**: PDF text extraction occurs entirely in the browser
- **User control**: Every field suggestion requires manual review and selection before filling
- **Multi-provider support**: Works with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and other OpenAI-compatible APIs
- **Safety mechanisms**: Built-in validation, timeout protection, and undo functionality
- **Cross-browser compatibility**: Supports both Chrome and Edge browsers

### Target Audience

- Professionals who frequently need to transfer data from PDFs to web forms
- Organizations seeking to automate repetitive form-filling tasks
- Users who want AI assistance while maintaining full control over their data

## Technical Architecture

The extension follows a modern browser extension architecture with clear separation of concerns across different execution contexts:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Side Panel UI] --> B[Background Service Worker]
    A --> C[Content Script]
    B --> C
    A --> D[AI Providers]
    C --> E[Web Page DOM]
    
    subgraph "Extension Context"
        A
        B
        D
    end
    
    subgraph "Page Context"
        C
        E
    end
```

### Component Breakdown

**1. Side Panel (React UI)**
- Main user interface for document upload, scanning, and review
- State management using React's useReducer pattern
- Real-time progress tracking and error handling

**2. Background Service Worker**
- Manages extension lifecycle and permissions
- Handles security validations and tab monitoring
- Provides trusted context for sensitive operations

**3. Content Scripts**
- Injected into target web pages to scan and fill forms
- Maintains secure communication channels with the side panel
- Implements form field detection and value manipulation

**4. AI Provider System**
- Pluggable architecture supporting multiple AI services
- Unified interface for different provider APIs
- Robust error handling and retry logic

### Design Patterns

- **Provider Pattern**: Abstracts different AI service implementations behind a common interface
- **Observer Pattern**: Tab state monitoring and event-driven updates
- **Command Pattern**: Encapsulates fill/undo operations as messages
- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic creation of AI provider instances

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Extension Manifest** (`src/manifest.json`)
- Defines Chrome Manifest V3 configuration
- Specifies required permissions and optional API host access
- Configures background service worker and side panel

**Background Service Worker** (`src/background/service-worker.ts`)
- Initializes storage access levels for trusted contexts
- Handles toolbar icon clicks to open side panel
- Validates active tab context for security

**Content Script Entry** (`src/content/index.ts`)
- Establishes secure communication with side panel
- Manages form scanning and filling operations
- Implements request/response messaging protocol

### Core Modules

**AI Provider System** (`src/ai/provider.ts`)
- Centralized provider creation and configuration
- Request building and response processing
- Error handling with retry logic and timeout protection

**Session Management** (`src/sidepanel/session.ts`)
- Comprehensive state machine for extension workflow
- Type-safe action dispatching with reducer pattern
- Secure page communication and validation

**PDF Processing** (`src/parsers/pdf.ts`)
- Client-side PDF text extraction using pdfjs-dist
- Streaming processing for large documents
- Progress reporting during parsing

### Configuration Approach

**TypeScript Configuration** (`tsconfig.json`)
- Modern ES module support with strict type checking
- Path aliases for cleaner imports
- Target compilation for browser environments

**Build Configuration** (`vite.config.ts`)
- Development server setup with hot reload
- Production build optimization
- Extension-specific bundling requirements

### External Dependencies

**Core Dependencies** (`package.json`)
- **React 19**: Modern UI framework for side panel
- **Zod 4**: Runtime type validation for all external data
- **pdfjs-dist**: PDF parsing and text extraction
- **Development tools**: TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Playwright

**AI Provider Integrations**
- OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.)
- Anthropic Claude API
- Google Gemini API

### Integration Points

**Chrome Extension APIs**
- `chrome.tabs`: Tab management and content script injection
- `chrome.storage`: Persistent settings and session data
- `chrome.scripting`: Dynamic code injection into web pages
- `chrome.sidePanel`: Modern side panel API usage

**Web Platform APIs**
- Fetch API for HTTP requests to AI providers
- AbortController for operation cancellation
- File API for local PDF processing

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Document Upload & Parsing**
- Drag-and-drop PDF upload interface
- Client-side text extraction without server uploads
- Progress indicators for large documents

**Form Scanning**
- Automatic detection of supported form fields
- Field metadata extraction (labels, types, current values)
- Exclusion rules for authentication/payment fields

**AI-Powered Mapping**
- Intelligent field-to-document mapping using AI
- Multi-attempt validation with automatic repair
- Usage tracking and cost transparency

**Review & Control**
- Interactive review table for all suggested mappings
- Selective field inclusion/exclusion
- Manual override capabilities

**Safe Form Filling**
- One-click filling of selected fields
- Undo functionality for mistake recovery
- Verification of successful field population

### Implementation Highlights

**Security Architecture** (`src/content/index.ts`)
- Strict origin validation for all cross-context communication
- Document identity verification to prevent hijacking
- Timeout-based connection management

**Error Handling** (`src/shared/errors.ts`)
- User-friendly error messages with actionable guidance
- Graceful degradation when features are unavailable
- Comprehensive logging for debugging

**Performance Optimization**
- Streaming PDF processing to handle large files
- Abort controller integration for responsive cancellation
- Memory management for long-running operations

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Parsing: Upload PDF
    Parsing --> Ready: Parse Complete
    Ready --> Scanning: Scan Page
    Scanning --> Review: Fields Found
    Review --> Mapping: Generate AI Plan
    Mapping --> Review: Show Suggestions
    Review --> Filling: Submit Selected
    Filling --> Complete: Fill Success
    Complete --> Review: Undo Changes
    Review --> [*]: Reset Session
```

## Conclusion and Recommendations

### Project Architecture Summary

Help Me Fill demonstrates a well-architected browser extension that successfully balances AI-powered automation with user privacy and control. The modular design enables easy extension with new AI providers while maintaining robust security boundaries between different execution contexts.

**Key Architectural Strengths:**
- Clear separation between extension contexts (background, content, side panel)
- Comprehensive type safety throughout the codebase
- Robust error handling and user feedback systems
- Pluggable AI provider architecture
- Strong security model with input validation and origin checking

### Potential Improvement Areas

**Performance Enhancements:**
- Implement caching for repeated form scans on the same page
- Add progressive loading for very large PDF documents
- Optimize AI request batching for better performance

**Feature Expansion:**
- Support for additional form element types beyond text inputs
- OCR capabilities for scanned PDF documents
- Export/import functionality for mapping templates
- Integration with password managers for credential fields

**Testing Coverage:**
- Expand unit test coverage for edge cases
- Add more comprehensive end-to-end tests for different form types
- Implement performance regression testing

### Next Steps for Project Evolution

1. **Stability Improvements**: Focus on error recovery and edge case handling
2. **User Experience**: Refine UI interactions and provide better guidance
3. **Provider Support**: Add support for additional AI providers and models
4. **Documentation**: Create comprehensive user documentation and developer guides
5. **Distribution**: Prepare for Chrome Web Store submission with proper icons and descriptions

The project represents a solid foundation for an AI-assisted form filling tool that prioritizes user control and privacy while leveraging modern web technologies and AI capabilities.

---

- [service-worker.ts](src/background/service-worker.ts)
- [App.tsx](src/sidepanel/App.tsx)
- [index.ts](src/content/index.ts)
- [provider.ts](src/ai/provider.ts)
- [session.ts](src/sidepanel/session.ts)

</blog>
